summary: The proof is sequentially valid. The moving-section density converges uniformly on the shrinking displacement intervals, the signed layer expansion and centroidal lower bound control all negative offsets, the strict open cover and positive gradient dependence control the positive offsets and give the needed one-sided first-order sum estimate, and the repaired contradiction argument correctly promotes the compactified-subsequence estimate to the full-sequence limsup. The claimed eventual inequality and final incompatibility with the accepted endpoint estimate follow.
